evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Delivered as a constitutive operational creed — an identity-level equivalence that treats rehearsal as the precondition for possession, stated with the permanence and universality of a bedrock principle.
A settled cadence declared as operational fact — the document records the decision as already in effect, not argued for.
Assignment of ownership ratifies the decision — a performed declarative that settles accountability as operational fact.
